mentions.name: Game asset management system
mentions.description: This is a digital asset management system for game development assets that integrates with Unreal Engine, Unity, and Blender. It is being built to organize and manage large collections of assets acquired from various stores or built by the developer, filling a gap left by asset management solutions that studios keep as private in-house tools. Nothing public yet; a release is targeted for September or October.
mentions.problem: Existing solutions for managing game development assets are largely in-house tools that studios build themselves and do not share, leaving individual game devs without good options for organizing large asset collections.
mentions.audience: game development hobbyists and indie developers managing large asset collections
mentions.source_excerpt: So I'm working on a digital asset management system that plays nicely with the tools I use; unreal engine, unity, and blender.
mentions.author: oneneptune
